title: Schrödinger operators with concentric $δ$--shell interactions
summary: We study Schrödinger operators on $\mathbb R^3$ with finitely many concentric spherical $δ$-shell interactions. The operators are defined by the quadratic form method and are described by continuity across each shell together with the usual jump condition for the radial derivative. Using a boundary integral approach based on the free Green kernel and single-layer potentials, we derive an explicit resolvent representation for an arbitrary number of shells with bounded coupling strengths.
